description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrValidator`, which is responsible for validating and transforming HTML token attributes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods to validate tokens, apply transformations, and ensure attributes conform to specifications.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrValidator
classes.description: A class dedicated to validating and transforming the attributes of HTML tokens, ensuring they adhere to defined rules and specifications within the HTMLPurifier system.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates and transforms attributes of a given HTML token, initializing necessary context, applying global and local transformations, validating attributes against definitions, and cleaning up the context.
